activities.description: Female reporter asks Doc Rivers for his thoughts on Kevin and Paul going to New Jersey.
Doc Rivers expresses sadness about the players leaving Boston but feels it's a good opportunity for them to win. He acknowledges it's a good trade for both Brooklyn and Boston.
Doc Rivers talks about Danny Ainge's plan to rebuild the Celtics.
Female reporter mentions Bill Simmons' comment about Doc Rivers quitting on the Celtics and asks for a response.
Doc Rivers implies Bill Simmons is an idiot but considers himself too classy to say it. He dismisses Simmons' opinion and claims he doesn't know the whole truth.
Female reporter thanks Doc Rivers and the segment ends.
